actions.answer: `interrupted_history` returns a new history list without replaying anything. For each entry, if it is a `tool_result` with a `batch_id` whose status is `pending`, `waiting_approval`, or `running`, it copies the entry and marks it as `status="interrupted"`, `is_error=True`, with content explaining that the prior execution was not completed or replayed. All other entries are copied unchanged. See `services/agentd-py/agentd/chat/batch_history.py:6-19`.
